_comment: Harness defaults; every install replaces this file. Your own defaults go in ~/.claude/harness-local/config.json and a project's in <project>/.claude/harness.json: each overrides the keys it names in the one before (keys merge two levels deep). Gate settings (globs, commands, timeouts) are separate: ~/.claude/gates/config.json and <project>/.claude/gates.json.

models._comment: The model of each role per tier; _active_tier is the one in force. A role in floor is never dispatched below its model (the dispatch hook refuses). adjust: when the orchestrator moves a role one step for a single dispatch.

adjust.fe-ui: sonnet when carrying out a decided change: a revision the user specified, syncing frames
adjust.fe-engineer: opus for feasibility and the queue, cross-stack rows, client state or the data layer, or where a written invariant is touched
adjust.fe-tester: opus when writing a new assertion that must be shown to fail

language._comment: Documents follow the user's language unless a project sets default_docs; stated in the kickoff preview, not asked.

review._comment: Backend panels (backend PLAYBOOK §6): design review runs only when risk is high; the review panel is trimmed by risk. The frontend panel is in frontend PLAYBOOK §6.

loops._comment: max_rounds: redo rounds each item may take at a step (fixes, revisions, re-work after an answer), counted from the run log; past it, the user decides (Constitution §5.4). continue_max_context: an author is continued (Constitution §8.1) only while its last request was at most this many tokens.

design_stop_rule._comment: Two stops (UX, then UI) when the round has at least min_pages_for_two pages or a new flow; otherwise one. Proposed at kickoff, confirmed by the user.

figma._comment: Frontend PLAYBOOK §1E. Counts every Figma MCP call made by fe-ux, fe-ui and fe-engineer, logged on their returns. per_page includes about 2 calls for a UX-stop wireframe.

taste._comment: Measured on every web capture of a product whose product_class is `tool`, and reported by fe-verify; it fails nothing. The values are those of skills/design-taste §1, §4 and §6: change them with the skill, or in a project whose brand differs. null leaves a measure out. font_families_max: families outside code. radius_px: the corner radii used, besides fully round. body_px: the size most of the text is set in. gradients_max: elements with a gradient background. dialogs_open_max: dialogs visible at once.

artifacts._comment: run_dir: where runs live, one directory per run (<run_dir>/<slug>/). A project may move it.
